stories.title: Tata Steel targets 50 million tonnes capacity
stories.summary: Tata Steel is targeting an expansion to 50 million tonnes of annual capacity over the next decade, with 75 percent of capital expenditure directed toward India. The company currently produces 27 million tonnes and is exploring a 15 million tonne greenfield plant in Maharashtra. Ambition remains steady.

stories.title: IOC receives government approval for sustainable aviation fuel
stories.summary: The Indian Oil Corporation has secured government approval to supply sustainable aviation fuel from its Panipat refinery. The facility is capable of meeting India's 1 percent blending mandate for international flights in 2027. The company plans to secure airline supply agreements before investing in additional production capacity.

stories.title: Horticulture output projected to hit record 386.9 million tonnes
stories.summary: India's horticultural production is expected to reach a record 386.9 million tonnes in the 2025-26 crop year, according to government estimates. This represents a 4.4 percent increase over the previous year, even as the total land area used for these crops has decreased to 29.7 million hectares.

stories.title: Modi advocates for cooperation in India-ASEAN relations
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi called for cooperation rather than competition to shape the future of India-ASEAN relations during the 23rd summit in Manila. He highlighted expanding ties in digital technology, defence and space, noting that the world requires predictability to navigate recent crises. Stability is the stated goal.

stories.title: India signals readiness for 1,000 aircraft order
stories.summary: Union minister Piyush Goyal stated that India is ready to order 1,000 more civilian aircraft to address an acute shortage and meet rising air traffic demand. The government is currently pursuing established manufacturers to accelerate supply. The country is seeking to expand connectivity, including new flights to Egypt.

stories.title: Unions propose 8th Pay Commission salary hikes
stories.summary: Employee unions have submitted a proposal to the 8th Central Pay Commission seeking a fitment factor of 3.833. If accepted, this would raise the minimum basic pay for central government employees from 18,000 to 69,000 rupees. The proposal also includes increased pension benefits for retirees and their families.

stories.title: Finance Ministry reviewing capital gains tax proposals
stories.summary: CBDT Chairman Ravi Agrawal stated that the government is examining industry proposals to rationalise long-term capital gains tax and securities transaction tax. Consultations are currently underway ahead of the Union Budget. Any final decisions will be announced only when the Budget is presented.

stories.title: Parliament passes MSME Development Amendment Bill
stories.summary: The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Amendment Bill was passed in August 2026. The legislation aims to reduce payment constraints, simplify compliance and establish time-bound dispute resolution. The government intends for these updates to facilitate growth and improve the ease of doing business for the sector.

stories.title: Manufacturing sector highlighted as pillar of self-reliance
stories.summary: As India marks its 80th Independence Day, the government is promoting the manufacturing sector through initiatives like the Production Linked Incentive scheme and PM GatiShakti. The sector now produces pharmaceuticals, defence equipment and heavy machinery at international standards. The country remains focused on its self-reliance vision.

stories.title: Rajasthan reports increase in investor applications
stories.summary: The Rajasthan government's Raj Nivesh single-window platform has seen a surge in investor applications. Officials attribute the rise to faster approvals and the integration of more services into the digital interface. The system has been in operation since 2020 to improve the ease of doing business.

stories.title: Sensex climbs as November rally continues
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex rose over 600 points and the Nifty crossed 25,450 on Tuesday. The market rally is supported by record foreign portfolio investor inflows. Institutional buying remains a factor as the November market trend continues.

stories.title: Bank Nifty reaches record high
stories.summary: The Bank Nifty index hit a fresh all-time high on Tuesday, crossing the 61,800 mark. The Nifty50 climbed above 25,450, supported by institutional buying and lower crude oil prices. Auto, PSU banks and realty sectors each recorded gains of over 1 percent during the mid-session.

stories.title: BSE shares rally 20 percent in one month
stories.summary: Shares of the Bombay Stock Exchange have risen 20 percent over the past month. The rally follows US regulatory clearance for the exchange's BANKEX futures and a recovery in trading activity. The bourse is currently evaluating the impact of zero transaction fees on future volume projections.

stories.title: Punjab National Bank shares hit eight-year high
stories.summary: Punjab National Bank shares rose 5 percent on Tuesday, reaching an eight-year high. The stock has increased 31 percent over the past month, marking six consecutive days of gains. The bank's share price movement continues to be supported by heavy trading volume.

stories.title: Nifty Realty index gains 14 percent in November
stories.summary: The Nifty Realty index rose 2.5 percent on Tuesday, bringing its November gains to 14 percent. Shares of DLF hit a 52-week high, while other developers saw rallies between 16 and 20 percent. The sector continues to report growth through new launches and premiumisation.

stories.title: NSE market capitalisation exceeds 5 trillion rupees
stories.summary: Shares of the National Stock Exchange reached a record high of 2,074 rupees on Monday, pushing its market capitalisation to 5.12 trillion rupees. The exchange is now the tenth largest by market value, surpassing LIC India. The surge follows buy recommendations from several brokerages.

stories.title: Nifty Bank index touches new peak
stories.summary: The Nifty Bank index reached a new peak of 61,875 on Tuesday, rising over 11 percent in the last month. Market experts attribute the performance to expectations of cooling inflation and a strong economy. The index has now surpassed levels last seen in February 2026.

stories.title: IT sector records rebound after six-month decline
stories.summary: The Nifty IT sector has rebounded 21 percent over the last four months following a six-month period as the worst-performing sector on the NSE. After a 17.7 percent rise in October, the sector has reduced its year-to-date losses to 14 percent. Trends remain subject to market volatility.

stories.title: ITC stock reclaims 200-day moving average
stories.summary: ITC shares have rallied 11 percent in November, crossing the 200-day moving average for the first time in over a year. Ajit Mishra of Religare Broking suggests the move is a rebound rather than a fresh uptrend, citing weak long-term chart structures. The stock remains under observation.

stories.title: Majority of NSE stocks trail 2025 closing levels
stories.summary: Data from ACE Equity shows that only 1,099 of 2,821 stocks traded on the NSE are currently above their December 31, 2025 closing prices. Despite several stocks hitting fresh highs this year, 39 percent of listed companies have yet to recover to their previous year-end levels.

stories.title: Castrol India faces 5,129 crore open offer
stories.summary: Motion JVCo has launched an open offer to acquire up to 26 percent of Castrol India at 199.45 rupees per share. The deal, valued at 5,129.29 crore rupees, is scheduled for the tendering period between December 24, 2026 and January 7, 2027. Public shareholding is expected to remain above 25

stories.title: Motion JVCo files offer for 26 percent stake in Castrol India
stories.summary: Motion JVCo Limited has filed a draft offer to acquire 26 percent of Castrol India from public shareholders at 199.45 rupees per share. The total potential outlay is 5,129.29 crore rupees. If completed, promoter holding may rise to 77 percent, reducing the public float.

stories.title: Sai Parenterals to acquire majority stake in Bion Therapeutics
stories.summary: Sai Parenterals will acquire a majority stake in Hyderabad-based Bion Therapeutics through its subsidiary SP Analytics. The all-cash deal is expected to close this month, turning Bion into a step-down subsidiary. The final acquisition cost will be determined by an independent valuer.

stories.title: Jakson Green acquires majority stake in Ocior Energy
stories.summary: Renewable energy platform Jakson Green has signed agreements to acquire a majority stake in Ocior Energy India. The acquisition is intended to expand Jakson Green's portfolio in green hydrogen and ammonia. The transaction value was not disclosed, and the company expects to announce the deal shortly.

stories.title: Jakson Green to acquire majority stake in Ocior Energy
stories.summary: Jakson Green has signed definitive agreements to acquire a majority stake in Ocior Energy India. The move aims to accelerate the development of green hydrogen, ammonia, and methanol projects. The company did not disclose the financial terms of the acquisition of the green energy developer.

stories.title: Muthoot FinCorp profit doubles to 779 crore rupees
stories.summary: Muthoot FinCorp reported a 101 percent increase in profit after tax to 779 crore rupees for the second quarter of FY27. Total income rose 71 percent to 3,408 crore rupees. Gross Stage III loan assets declined to 1.07 percent ahead of the lender's proposed 3,000 crore rupee IPO.

stories.title: XTGlobal Infotech receives RBI approval for Irish investment
stories.summary: XTGlobal Infotech has received Reserve Bank of India approval to invest 10,000 euros in its Irish subsidiary, XTG Infotech Europe Limited. The subsidiary, incorporated in July 2026, will provide IT consulting and finance services as part of the parent company's European expansion strategy.

stories.title: IDP Education rejects Blackstone takeover bid
stories.summary: IDP Education has rejected a third takeover proposal from Blackstone, which valued the company at approximately 573.3 million US dollars. The board described the 3 Australian dollar-per-share cash offer as opportunistic and stated that it does not reflect the company's future earnings potential.

stories.title: FSSAI issues show cause notice to Red Bull
stories.summary: The FSSAI has asked Red Bull to provide scientific substantiation for marketing its product as an energy drink. The regulator noted that a significant portion of the drink's energy content is derived from added sugar. Red Bull has seven days to respond to the notice.

stories.title: NCDRC upholds 20 lakh rupee fine on Exporters India
stories.summary: The National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission upheld a 20 lakh rupee penalty against ExportersIndia.com for listing hazardous explosive substances. The ruling supports the Central Consumer Protection Authority's efforts to hold online marketplaces accountable for items listed on their platforms by third-party sellers.

stories.title: RBI reiterates listing mandate for Tata Sons
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has written to Tata Sons, reiterating that the company must comply with regulatory requirements for upper-layer non-banking financial companies. This includes a mandatory stock market listing. The central bank stated that Tata Sons had not sought clarification on these specific norms.

stories.title: RBI tells Tata Sons to comply with listing norms
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has advised Tata Sons to adhere to the regulatory framework for upper-layer non-banking financial companies, which includes a requirement to list on the stock exchange. The central bank reinforced that systemically important entities must follow these rules without seeking special dispensations.

stories.title: IDBI Bank unions oppose Fairfax takeover
stories.summary: IDBI Bank employee unions have asked the Reserve Bank of India to withhold approval for the transfer of management control to Fairfax Financial Holdings. The unions are calling for an independent examination of the transaction and have announced a nationwide strike for December 3.

stories.title: IDBI Bank employees to strike on December 3
stories.summary: IDBI Bank employee unions have announced a nationwide strike for December 3 to protest the proposed sale of a majority stake to Canada-based Fairfax Financial Holdings. The strike will affect branches across the country, marking the second industrial action by the unions within a month.

stories.title: IDBI Bank unions call nationwide strike
stories.summary: IDBI Bank employee unions have called for a nationwide strike on December 3 to oppose the proposed sale of a majority stake to Fairfax Financial Holdings. The unions cite concerns regarding the bank's public-sector character and the implications of transferring control to a private investor.

stories.title: JSW Steel CEO highlights export and trade challenges
stories.summary: JSW Steel CEO Jayant Acharya identified a surge in cheaper steel imports from China and international trade barriers as primary challenges for the industry. He added that India needs to open more iron ore mines to ensure raw material supplies and support future growth.

stories.title: Tata Steel seeks UK market support and Dutch green funds
stories.summary: Tata Steel is seeking UK government intervention to address a backlog of imported steel and negotiating state funding in the Netherlands for its green transition. The company cites a massive Chinese supply glut disrupting global trade. The inventory remains, even if the window for imports has closed.

stories.title: EU imposes anti-dumping duties on Indian steel imports
stories.summary: The European Commission has imposed anti-dumping duties of 9.5 percent on certain cold-rolled flat steel products from India. The measures also apply to Japan, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam following an investigation into dumped prices. Japan faces the highest duty at 27.9 percent.

stories.title: EU sets 9.5 percent tariff on Indian steel producers
stories.summary: The European Commission is imposing tariffs on cold-rolled flat steel products used in construction and appliances. Indian firms including JSW Steel and Tata Steel face a 9.5 percent duty. The commission found the products were being sold at unfairly low prices within the European Union.

stories.title: JSW and Tata Steel shares in focus after EU tariff decision
stories.summary: Shares of JSW Steel and Tata Steel are expected to be in focus following the European Commission's decision to impose a 9.5 percent anti-dumping duty on certain steel products. The financial impact depends on the ability of domestic steelmakers to pass these additional costs to customers.

research.title: The Anatomy of Value Creation: Input-Output Linkages, Policy Shifts, and Economic Impacts
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper describes the construction of high-resolution 7-digit product-level Supply-Use Tables (SUTs) and symmetric Input-Output Tables (IOTs) for the Indian economy from 2016-17 to 2022-23, primarily utilising microdata from the Annual Survey of Industries (ASI). It. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: A Game of Throngs: How Spotlight Tourism Reshapes Local Economies
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: In July 2017, San Juan de Gaztelugatxe, a modest chapel in the Basque Country, appeared as "Dragonstone" in Game of Thrones, transforming a locally known site with limited tourism activity into a global tourist destination overnight. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: China's Local Government Debt, Strategic Competition, and Bitcoin Demand: A Conditional Transmission Framework
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: How might the resolution of China's local-government debt affect strategic competition and Bitcoin demand? This paper develops a conditional framework connecting debt accounting, bank balance-sheet adjustment, public spending priorities, and constrained portfolio substitution. A debt swap. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Complements or Substitutes? Technology Adoption and Clinical Care Utilization: Evidence from Automated Insulin Delivery
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Whether medical technology reduces or increases demand for professional care is central to understanding its effects on healthcare utilization and costs. We study automated insulin delivery (AID) adoption among 1,608 adults with type 1 diabetes treated. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Corporate Stances on Societal Issues in the US
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: When do firms take public positions on divisive societal issues and why? We assemble a comprehensive dataset on corporate stance-taking in the United States, using large language models to read 52,000 news articles and press releases. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Economic Power in International Trade
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Economic power is a country's capacity to harm another more than itself by withdrawing from a trading relationship. This paper develops a general equilibrium model of the world trade network to measure that power through counterfactual. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: How an Economy Shrinks in Space: Concavity-on-Jobs and Upward Consolidation under Demographic Decline
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: When a country's population declines, the aggregate economy appears to contract on the intensive margin: industrial diversity intact, every industry a little smaller. At the regional level, contraction is uneven and takes the extensive form: entire. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: How optimistic inflow forecasts distort dispatch, prices, and contracts in hydro-dominated power systems: evidence from Brazil
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Centralized hydrothermal planning models determine generation schedules and electricity spot prices based on inflow forecasts in audited-cost power systems, such as those prevalent in Latin America, and provide operational benchmarks and decision support in hydro-dominated competitive. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
